text:
sam_docs: quick sync 1 have a small docs PR to harmonize function-calling examples across languages. noticed issues in migration guide links and a couple of broken snippets. PTAL @kelly_sdk @jamie_prod
kelly_sdk: what are the main failures?
sam_docs: 1) python shows `print(resp)` which prints envelope; 2) js streaming example forgot `await`; 3) schema example used `additionalProperties: true` instead of demonstrating `oneOf` for union outputs
jamie_prod: agreed we should show a normalization pattern for union responses. suggest short snippet: if string -> JSON.parse / json.loads. also show `nullable: true` vs omission semantics
kelly_sdk: i'll update the SDK snippets to call an `unwrapEnvelope` helper in both languages and add a streaming test for js. will also add a short unit test in docs repo to catch missing `await`
sam_docs: please include examples for tool outputs that are `null` vs omitted (support keeps asking). small FAQ entry titled 'Tool output: null vs absent vs envelope'
fmt-bot: link-check: migration/function-calling.md had two stale anchors  fixed by PR 701
kelly_sdk: PR 701 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/701  includes snippet fixes, tests, and migration-guide anchor updates
jamie_prod: LGTM on examples, added a note on choosing `oneOf` for strict vs permissive guardrails
sam_docs: merging after CI green. will follow up with a request to devex to add cookbook variants in other language samples
fmt-bot: CI: lint and linkcheck passed
kelly_sdk: merged. thanks everyone :tada:
